items.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger
items.rights_evidence: Disney UK Press (26 Aug 2026) identifies the new trailer and poster as official press material and states they are available to view and share; Disney Press is the official media portal.

items.title: The Dog Stars
items.rights_evidence: Disney/20th Century UK Press (14 Jul 2026) explicitly states the final trailer is available to download and share; press stills are also supplied.

items.title: Whalefall
items.rights_evidence: Disney/20th Century UK Press (19 Aug 2026) publishes the new official trailer and poster with press stills for media coverage.

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
items.rights_evidence: Disney/20th Century UK Press (2 Feb 2026) provides the official trailer plus character posters and stills through the studio press portal for editorial/media coverage.

items.title: Furious
items.rights_evidence: Disney+ UK Press (26 Jun 2026) unveiled the official trailer and downloadable key art for the series; the same official press portal reported its second-season renewal on 28 Aug 2026.

items.title: Camp Rock 3
items.rights_evidence: Disney+ UK Press (22 Jul 2026) publishes the official trailer and explicitly provides downloadable key art and press materials for media coverage.

items.title: The Shards
items.rights_evidence: Disney+/FX UK Press (14 Jul 2026) unveiled the official trailer and provides downloadable key art via the Disney media portal.

items.title: Hexed
items.rights_evidence: Disney Animation UK Press (16 Jun 2026) makes the first official trailer, poster and image assets available through its press-material links for media/editorial coverage.

items.title: Hoppers
items.rights_evidence: Disney/Pixar UK Press (16 Jul 2025) explicitly states the trailer, poster and trailer stills are available to download and share.

items.title: Gatto
items.rights_evidence: Disney/Pixar UK Press (11 Jun 2026) publishes the first official trailer, poster and stills with press-material links through the official media portal.
